These two files are the outputs of one LitScout (Python) run, copied from the `examples/legal-rag-run` branch of
https://github.com/Hoanghung0603/LitScout (query "Vietnamese legal GraphRAG", 3 rounds, 72 records retrieved,
52 unique, 3 selected). They are the expected output of `export_test.go`: the Go exporter must reproduce them from
a state built from the same selected papers.
